# What will this fundraising event actually net?

> Free fundraising event calculator for galas, auctions and benefit dinners: enter tickets, sponsors, auction, giving and costs, and get net proceeds, cost per dollar raised, break-even guests and the ticket price that reaches your goal. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
